The Commencement Date of the Sublease is November 1, 2008 and the Expiration Date is September 29, 2105, unless terminated sooner in accordance with the Sublease. The Sublease does not grant Subtenant any option to renew or extend the term of the Sublease. 4. All capitalized terms used, but not otherwise defined herein, shall have themeanings ascribed to them in theSublease. 5.
